acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

attest(bytes32,uint256,uint256,bytes[]).details: Replay protection: the oracle is intentionally stateless w.r.t.      attestation history. The signed payload contains no nonce —      replay is prevented by `IntentQueue.recordAttestation`, which      reverts on any second attestation for the same `(intentId,      slotIndex)` (`IntentQueue_SlotAlreadyAttested`). The      `(intentId, slotIndex)` tuple is itself a globally-unique      "implicit nonce" within this oracle/queue pair, so a signature      can only be successfully consumed once.      Permissionless by design: anyone may submit a valid signature      batch. The trust boundary is the SIGNERS, not the poster.

attestRedemption(bytes32,uint256,bytes32.details: Same trust model and replay story as {attest}, but bound to      the SEPARATE {ASYNC_LEG_DELIVERY_TYPEHASH}. Replay key      generalizes to `(redemptionId, legIndex)` — enforced in      `IntentQueue.recordRedemptionAttestation` via the per-leg      `IntentQueue_LegAlreadyAttested` /      `IntentQueue_LegMutexViolated` guards.

params.assetId: Canonical asset id of the leg        (e.g. `keccak256("BTC.BTC")`). Bound by the typed-data        digest AND re-checked at the queue layer.
params.deliveredAmount: USDT THORChain delivered for this leg.
params.legIndex: Index of the leg within the redemption.
params.redemptionId: The redemption the attestation belongs to.
params.signatures: Array of 65-byte ECDSA signatures (r || s || v).

attestRefund(bytes32,uint256,bytes32,uin.details: Same trust model and k-of-n machinery as {attest}, bound to      the SEPARATE {ASYNC_LEG_REFUND_TYPEHASH}. Authorizes the      refunded-leg branch of the unified `finalizeBurn` terminal      by PROVING THORChain refunded `refundedAmount` of `assetId`      for this `legIndex` to our multisig (verify-the-refund —      never deadline-trust). Per-leg mutex + replay live in      `IntentQueue.recordRefundAttestation`.

params.assetId: Canonical asset id of the leg.
params.legIndex: Index of the refunded leg within the redemption.
params.refundedAmount: Native asset THORChain returned for this        leg to our multisig (inbound − outbound fee).

params.initialOwner: Owner permitted to add/remove signers and set threshold.
params.initialSigners: Initial signer set; deduplicated implicitly via the mapping.
params.initialThreshold: Initial k-of-n threshold; must be ≥ 1 and ≤ initialSigners.length.
params.intentQueue_: The IntentQueue this oracle writes into.

eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

unpause().details: Reverts if the threshold is still zero. `removeSigner`-to-zero      force-lowers `_threshold` to 0 and auto-pauses; without this      guard an owner who `addSigner` + `unpause` but forgets      `setThreshold` would relive the oracle with `_threshold == 0`,      where `_verifyKofN`'s `sigCount < threshold` is never true and      a SINGLE valid signer's attestation would pass while the      operator believes a k-of-n is in force. Forcing a sane      threshold before re-enabling closes the gap the auto-pause      was added to protect.

ASYNC_LEG_DELIVERY_TYPEHASH().notice: The EIP-712 typehash for the per-leg         {AsyncLegDeliveryAttestation} struct (REDEMPTION-DELIVERY).         Structurally distinct from {ATTESTATION_TYPEHASH}: different         struct name and fields ⇒ different `_hashTypedDataV4`         digest ⇒ a mint signature can never verify here, with no         runtime `kind` check to forget. The in-payload `assetId`         binds each signature to a specific leg's asset (defeats         leg-index confusion across heterogeneous baskets).

ASYNC_LEG_REFUND_TYPEHASH().notice: EIP-712 typehash for the per-leg {AsyncLegRefundAttestation}         — the THIRD structurally-distinct typehash (mint /         leg-delivery / leg-refund). Signers attest THORChain         refunded `refundedAmount` of `assetId` for this `legIndex`         to our multisig. Distinct struct ⇒ distinct digest ⇒ a mint         or delivery signature can never verify here.

ATTESTATION_TYPEHASH().notice: The EIP-712 typehash for the {Attestation} struct (MINT).         The off-chain Rust signer MUST use the same string verbatim.

attest(bytes32,uint256,uint256,bytes[]).notice: Verifies `signatures` against the EIP-712 hash of the         mint-slot attestation triple and, if `≥ threshold` unique         active signers are recovered, calls         `IntentQueue.recordAttestation`.

attestRedemption(bytes32,uint256,bytes32.notice: Verifies `signatures` against the EIP-712 hash of the         per-leg {AsyncLegDeliveryAttestation} and, if `≥ threshold`         unique active signers are recovered, calls         `IntentQueue.recordRedemptionAttestation`. Uses the same         signer set and threshold as {attest} but a SEPARATE         typehash, so a mint signature cannot satisfy this path.

attestRefund(bytes32,uint256,bytes32,uin.notice: Verifies `signatures` against the EIP-712 hash of the         per-leg {AsyncLegRefundAttestation} and, if `≥ threshold`         unique active signers are recovered, calls         `IntentQueue.recordRefundAttestation`. Authorizes the         refunded-leg branch of the unified `finalizeBurn`         terminal by proving THORChain refunded the native asset —         never by deadline. Third SEPARATE typehash: a mint or         delivery signature cannot satisfy this path.

attestationHash((bytes32,uint256,uint256.notice: EIP-712 digest the off-chain signer must sign for a MINT slot.

pause().notice: Halts new attestations. Existing attestations and queue         state are unaffected; this is incident-response only, not         a permanent kill-switch. Owner-only.

redemptionAttestationHash((bytes32,uint2.notice: EIP-712 digest for a per-leg redemption delivery         attestation. Separate struct ⇒ never interchangeable with         the mint or refund digests.

refundAttestationHash((bytes32,uint256,b.notice: EIP-712 digest for a per-leg refund attestation. Third         distinct struct ⇒ never interchangeable.

@title AttestationOracle
 @notice k-of-n EIP-712 signer multisig that gates `IntentQueue` attestations.
 @dev   Off-chain signers each independently observe partner-network
        deposits/withdrawals and sign an EIP-712 typed-data message
        with their HSM-backed key. A keeper aggregates ≥ `threshold`
        signatures and posts them via the `attest*` entrypoints. The
        oracle recovers each signer, deduplicates, checks active
        membership, and on success forwards the attestation to
        {IntentQueue}.
        Phase 3.0: three structurally-distinct typehashes — mint slot,
        **per-leg** redemption-delivery, and **per-leg** refund. The
        `legIndex` + `assetId` fields in the redemption typehashes
        bind each signature to a specific leg's asset, defeating
        leg-index confusion across heterogeneous baskets without a
        runtime `kind` discriminator.
